battle.name: 魏攻統萬之戰
battle.brief: 始光三年（426），北魏太武帝拓跋燾分道伐夏；翌年五月率輕兵三萬西行，夜抵統萬城下，破城擒其主赫連昌，大夏國亡。統萬牆以蒸土築成，攻守之爭全在攻城器械、糧秣與突進速度；卡面這件羅馬重步兵所代表的重裝步兵母題，正落在城頭防線與攻城雲梯之間。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 交戰一方是北魏。太武帝拓跋燾以平城為都，此時北魏已平代北與並州，並在涼州東段置郡置鎮，但河北仍與據龍城、幽州的北燕相持，河西則由北涼沮渠氏名義歸順而實則自治。魏國的戰力來自拓跋、賀蘭、奚、斛律等內附鮮卑諸部的騎兵，以及河朔、河套、關中郡縣的徵發兵與屯田戶。軍隊編制沿八部舊制而由大將分道統兵，拓跋燾自領中軍，別遣諸將當東、西兩道，互為掎角；參軍謀主多出自代北舊族與漢人降將，崔浩掌檄令與戰略。另一方是大夏，赫連勃勃以匈奴鐵弗部為主建立的政權，定都陝西靖邊無定河北岸的統萬城，國土北臨河套、南接關中、西抵河西走廊東端，控住的正是北魏與宋、涼三方交會的交通樞紐。大夏以鐵弗部騎兵為骨幹，漢人與氐、羌部眾為附，宿衛與城防交由近衛騎士和重裝步兵擔當，統萬城牆以蒸土築成，城分上中下三重，外郭連城環繞。兩國相爭的核心因此不是一場會戰的勝負，而是對西北那座巨型堡壘的爭奪。
countriesEn: The belligerent on one side was Northern Wei. Emperor Taiwu Tuoba Tao governed from Pingcheng, and by 426 the state had pacified Daobei and Bingzhou and had set up commanderies and garrisons in the eastern part of Liangzhou, though in Hebei it was still locked in a contest with Northern Yan, which held Longcheng and Youzhou, and in Hexi the Northern Liang house of the Juqu clan nominally submitted to Wei while in fact governed itself. Wei's fighting strength came from the cavalry of the Tujue, Helan, Xi and Helü tribal groups that had submitted to the dynasty, from levies drawn in the commanderies of Heshuo, Hetao and Guanzhong, and from the households of the tuntian farms. The army still followed the old Eight Divisions structure, with the emperor himself commanding the central army and other generals assigned to the eastern and western routes so that the three columns could cover one another; the planners of the campaign came both from the old aristocratic families of Daobei and from Han Chinese commanders who had surrendered. The other side was the Great Xia state of Helian Bobo, built around the Xiongnu Tiefu clan and seated at Tongwan City on the north bank of the Wuding River in present-day Jingbian, Shaanxi. Its territory reached north to the Hetao pastures, south to Guanzhong and west to the eastern end of the Hexi Corridor, and it therefore held the hinge where Wei, Song and Liang met. Xia relied on Tiefu cavalry, supplemented by Han Chinese and Di-Qiang auxiliaries; the palace guard and the city garrison were manned by close guard horsemen and heavy infantry. The walls of Tongwan were rammed from steamed earth, the city had three tiers and was ringed by an outer line of linked fortifications. The real stake of the conflict was therefore not the result of a single pitched battle but the possession of that enormous fortress in the northwest.
people: 決策核心是北魏太武帝拓跋燾。他少年即位，此後先後平定劉裕留下的河北殘局、壓住北面的柔然、又在河西伸手，故而他很清楚赫連勃勃的暴虐不足以服眾，真正下定決心的是地理：夏國據河套、擁統萬，等於掐住北魏往河西與關中伸展的咽喉。他下詔伐夏，詔文把出兵寫成討無道，又明令各軍按部次行軍、不得輕進妄進，把政治訴求擺在軍紀之前。謀主是崔浩。崔浩力主出兵，並反對在統萬城下耗時間，主張以奇制：輕兵疾進，不與夏軍戀戰，直抵城下，再以步騎並進奪其城；參軍崔辯等贊同此議。代北宿將長孫嵩、斛律金、奚康一輩此時已掌重兵，其後在北伐柔然的大戰中成為北魏騎兵的中堅。夏國主赫連昌是赫連勃勃幼子，父死時年紀尚幼，倉促嗣位，性好酒色而御下無威，號令不出宮門；輔政的匈奴舊臣與漢人將領各懷異心，兵無所統一。城破之日，昌與少數騎兵趁夜逃往上邽，其弟赫連定等北走投奔吐谷渾，後來在西北另建政權，數年後才被平定。
peopleEn: The decision at the centre was Emperor Taiwu Tuoba Tao himself. He had taken the throne as a boy, and had since settled the Hebei residue of Liu Yu's regime, kept the Rouran in check on his northern flank and extended his authority westward, so he judged that the 'cruel and lawless rule' of Helian Bobo was not what mattered; what mattered was geography. With Xia holding Hetao and Tongwan, the throat of the road by which Wei meant to expand toward Hexi and Guanzhong was being gripped. He issued the edict of campaign, framing it as the punishment of a tyrant, and at the same time fixed the order of march and the discipline of the columns so that the political purpose of the war came before anything else. The chief planner was Cui Hao, who urged the attack and argued against grinding away at Tongwan; his plan was a surprise: light troops moving fast, refusing to be drawn into a general engagement, pressing straight to the city wall, where infantry and cavalry would strike together. Cui Bian and the other staff officers concurred. Seasoned commanders of Daibei origin such as Zhangsun Song, Hulü Jin and Xi Kang already held heavy commands, and they would form the backbone of Wei's cavalry in the later war against the Rouran. On the Xia side the ruler was Helian Chang, the young son of Helian Bobo, who inherited the throne while still a child, was fond of wine and pleasure, and had no real authority over his subordinates, so that his orders never reached beyond the palace gate; the Xiongnu old nobles and the Han Chinese ministers about him were divided in their loyalties, and the army was never a single will. On the night the city fell Chang escaped with a few horsemen towards Shanggui, while his brother Helian Ding and others fled north to Tuyuhun, where they set up a state of their own that was not extinguished for several more years.
kits: 本站這張卡的本體是羅馬重步兵，設計年標在公元前 100 年上下，兵種定位是重步兵：分段鎧甲、重盾、標槍與短劍，靠密集的縱深佇列與盾牆頂住正面衝鋒，再由後排投射標槍打散敵陣，鋼製武器是輔，編制才是骨。要說清楚的是，羅馬軍團步兵從未踏上中國的土地，這張卡在本站兵器譜系裡，是以重裝步兵這一兵種母題，去對照四百多年後西北高原上真刀真槍的攻防。真實的裝備是這樣對應的：北魏大軍的骨幹是騎兵，拓跋燾在始光年間已令軍中備重甲，披甲上馬者漸增，後來北伐柔然時以鐵騎為鋒，與羅馬重步兵的重裝邏輯同源而載具不同；步兵方面，魏軍列陣用大盾、長槊，弩手居後，用以覆蓋騎兵衝鋒的兩翼。大夏一方，統萬城頭上是弩手與擲石手，備檑、鹿角與拒馬，牆面因蒸土築造而堅如鐵，守方把重裝步兵與防禦器械綁成了一體。攻城端，魏軍依當時攻城通例備雲梯、撞車與鉤援之具，並以布幔遮蔽城頭的矢石。後勤這一環同樣對得上：羅馬靠補充兵源與補給線，魏靠河套、河西的屯田與牛車運糧；史稱此次西征只備旬日芻糧、輕兵疾行，沿途取給於屯田與徵發，這正是羅馬軍團那條戰力不靠重裝而靠補給線的道理在東亞的翻版。
kitsEn: The card itself is the Roman legionary, dated to about 100 BC and positioned in this collection as the archetype of the heavy infantryman: segmental armour, a heavy shield, the pilum and a short sword, fighting in dense ranks behind a wall of shields, the rear ranks throwing pila to disorder an enemy before the shield line closed on it. Steel is the secondary matter here; the order of battle is the real one. It should be stated plainly that a Roman legionary never set foot in China: on this site the card functions as a vocabulary piece for the heavy-infantry idea, set against the real armour and siege work fought out on the northwestern plateau four and a half centuries later. The correspondence in practice runs as follows. The backbone of the Wei army was cavalry; from the early Shiguang years Tuoba Tao had men equipped with heavy armour riding armoured horses, and the armoured lancers formed the spearhead of the later war against the Rouran, the same logic of weight as the Roman heavy infantryman carried on a different mount. In the line, Wei infantry advanced with large shields and long spears, with crossbowmen behind them covering the flanks of the cavalry charge. On the Xia side the wall of Tongwan was manned by crossbowmen and slingers, with logs, caltrops and spiked barriers, and the steamed-earth construction made the face of the wall as hard as metal: the defenders had fused heavy infantry with fortification into a single system. On the attacking side the Wei engineers followed the usual practice of the day, bringing scaling ladders, battering rams and hooked climbing gear, and covering the crews with hides against the missiles from the wall. Logistics matches as well. Rome fought on the strength of recruitment and supply lines; Wei fought on the strength of the tuntian farms of Hetao and Hexi and on ox-carts moving grain. The western expedition of 427 is recorded as carrying barely ten days of fodder and moving light, drawing its supplies from the farms and levies along the route, which is the Roman lesson that war is not decided by armour but by the supply line, repeated in East Asia.
tactics: 426 年的第一輪用兵是三道並進：拓跋燾自領中軍當中路，另遣兩翼將軍分趨東西，目的是先斷夏國的外援與糧道，把統萬孤立，而不是立刻攻城。魏軍沿途攻破夏國邊城，略有輻重，同時避免與夏國騎兵糾纏；夏軍節節退保統萬，城守堅固，魏軍攻城未能得手，第一次出兵便收兵而還。代北騎兵不習攻堅，這一課的教訓直接餵給了第二年。427 年的作法則完全不同：諸將在軍中商議，認為統萬城蒸土築成、堅如鐵，正面強攻代價太大，太武帝與崔浩因此定下奇襲之策，輕兵三萬兼程疾行，不與敵接戰，盡量不驚動夏軍。隊伍越過河套，進入夏境後仍在行軍，接近統萬才停下宿營；將士銜枚，斥候往來，逼近城下百里之內才入夜前進，夜半抵達統萬城下，拂曉發起進攻。守軍在睡夢中被驚醒，倉促列陣；魏軍攻城器械齊備，步軍攀城而上，與城頭守軍逐段爭奪，先登者突入城中，夏軍的抵抗節節崩解，赫連昌趁夜出奔。魏軍遣輕騎追至上邽，昌為追兵所擒，後送平城。破城之後，魏軍盡取府庫兵仗與馬匹，留兵鎮守，班師回平城。
tacticsEn: The first round in 426 went in on three columns. Tuoba Tao took the central route himself and other generals were sent east and west, the object being to cut Xia's reinforcements and supply and to isolate Tongwan rather than to assault the walls at once. Wei took Xia's frontier forts as it advanced and collected what it could, while refusing to be bogged down by Xia's horsemen; the Xia army fell back step by step to Tongwan, the siege that followed failed, and the first expedition withdrew without result. Daibei cavalrymen were no hand at siege work, and the lesson of 426 fed directly into the plan of 427. The method in 427 was altogether different. In council the generals judged that Tongwan, rammed from steamed earth and hard as metal, was too costly to take by frontal assault, and Tuoba Tao with Cui Hao settled on a surprise: thirty thousand light troops pushing at speed, refusing contact, and moving as quietly as possible. They crossed the Hetao and entered Xia territory still on the march, halted to make camp only when close to Tongwan, and with the column closed up and outriders posted advanced at night, reaching the walls around midnight and striking at daybreak. The garrison was woken out of sleep and drew up in disorder; the Wei assault went up with the usual siege gear, the parapet was fought over section by section, the first men over the wall broke into the city, and the Xia line came apart, Helian Chang slipping out in the night. Light cavalry pursued him to Shanggui, where he was caught and later taken to Pingcheng. After the city fell the Wei took the treasury, the arms and the horses, left a garrison behind, and marched home.
data: 可以核對的數字有幾組。其一，427 年奇襲時的魏軍規模，《魏書》記為輕兵三萬，步兵另計，總數在數萬之譜；出發時只備旬日芻糧，走的是急行軍節奏。其二，統萬城的形制，《水經注》記城方三里餘，牆基甚闊，築法用蒸土，堅如鐵，城內另有內城，外郭連城環繞，一城之內可屯兵數千而街巷不見空隙。其三，戰役時間表：426 年春出師，首次攻城不下而還；427 年五月再出師，同年六月城破，七月班師；428 年赫連昌被擒送平城處死；大夏殘部至 431 年方告結束。其四，收穫：城破後魏軍取其府庫，馬匹以萬計，兵器糧秣足支數年；統萬守軍人數史無詳，僅記兵少而將吏不能統一。其五，距離與補給：平城至統萬相距逾一千四百里，輕騎疾行仍需旬日，糧秣全賴沿途屯田與就地徵發。其六，兵源與戰力結構：北魏可用之兵出自拓跋、賀蘭、奚、斛律四部與漢人郡縣徵發，騎兵為主，步兵次之。
dataEn: Several sets of figures can be checked. First, the size of the Wei force in 427: the Wei histories record thirty thousand light troops, with the infantry counted separately, so the total was of the order of tens of thousands; only about ten days of fodder was carried and the march was run at a forced pace. Second, the form of Tongwan: the Shuijing Zhu devotes a passage to it, describing a city over three li square with exceptionally thick walls built by the steamed-earth method and hard as metal, an inner citadel within it, and a ring of linked outer works, able to hold several thousand men without the streets showing any slack. Third, the timetable: the first expedition set out in the spring of 426 and returned after failing at the walls; the second set out in the fifth month of 427, the city fell in the sixth, and the army was back in the seventh; Helian Chang was captured and executed at Pingcheng in 428, and the remaining Xia forces were not finished off until 431. Fourth, the spoil: the Wei took the treasury of the city, horses by the tens of thousands, and stores of arms and grain sufficient for several years; the number of the garrison is nowhere recorded, only that the troops were few and that the officers and men could not be brought to order. Fifth, distance and supply: Pingcheng and Tongwan lie more than 1,400 li apart, and even light horse needed about ten days to ride it at speed, with grain drawn entirely from the tuntian farms and levies along the way. Sixth, manning and force structure: Wei's available troops came from the Tujue, Helan, Xi and Helü divisions and from Han Chinese levies in the commanderies, with cavalry in the main and infantry second.
cause: 赫連勃勃於 425 年死，赫連昌以幼子嗣位。北魏遣使往封，昌不受詔命，反而遣使與南朝往來，兩邊的關係就此破裂，太武帝把這視為夏國自絕，藉口遂成。但真正的原因是地理與戰略。夏國控統萬，北控河套牧地，南接關中，東與北魏代郡、太原相接，卡住了北魏由平城向西南伸展的通道；北涼沮渠氏盤踞河西，夏國一亡，涼州與關中就再無遮蔽。北魏的統一計劃本來是先安北方的柔然、再掃西北的割據，426 年出兵正是按這個次序走的一步。赫連勃勃的暴政與都城興築之苦，也被北魏寫進詔書，成為討無道的說辭，太武帝並專門下詔約束各軍，不許劫掠。直接導火線出現在 427 年：夏國拒絕一切條件，魏廷確認已無路可走，遂決定不再正面強攻，改以奇襲一舉奪城，把第一次出兵的教訓換成了第二次的方案。
causeEn: Helian Bobo died in 425 and Helian Chang, his young son, succeeded. Wei sent an envoy to invest him as King of Xia; Chang would not accept the commission and instead opened relations with the southern court, and the two sides broke. Tuoba Tao read the refusal as Xia cutting itself off, and the casus belli was complete. But the deeper reason was geographical and strategic. Xia held Tongwan, commanding the Hetao pastures to the north, touching Guanzhong to the south and the Wei frontier districts of Dai and Taiyuan to the east, and it blocked the corridor along which Wei intended to expand southwest. The Northern Liang house of the Juqu clan sat on Hexi; once Xia fell, Liangzhou and Guanzhong would be left without a screen. Wei's plan of unification was to settle the Rouran first and then clear the separatist states of the northwest, and the expedition of 426 was the next step in that order. The brutality of Helian Bobo's government and the hardship of the great building works were entered into Wei's edict as the justification for punishing a tyrant, and Tuoba Tao separately ordered the troops not to plunder. The immediate trigger came in 427: Xia refused every term, the court concluded that no negotiated settlement remained possible, and instead of another frontal assault it decided on the surprise that carried the city, turning the lesson of the first expedition into the plan of the second.
impact: 統萬陷落標誌著大夏的崩解。赫連昌被擒斬，赫連定北走吐谷渾，後來在西北重建政權，到 431 年才被平定；夏國經營了二十餘年的西北霸權，一朝歸於北魏。對北魏而言，收回統萬不只是取下一座城。河套的屯田得以恢復與擴張，平城到涼州的通道被打開，移民實邊，馬匹與糧秣的來源增加；這份補給能力，正是 429 年起北魏大舉北伐柔然、以及 439 年滅北涼的底子。河西沮渠氏在夏亡之後失去了西面的屏障，到 439 年北涼被滅，涼州正式併入北魏版圖，北方統一才真正完成。在城市史上，統萬是中國中古史上規模最大的夯土堡壘之一，蒸土築牆的技術與壯闊城郭成為後世考古的重要材料；其後城市漸廢，河道改易，舊址只剩殘垣。在兵制史上，這場戰爭提供了兩組對照：一個是守方把重裝步兵與城防器械結合到極致、幾近無解，最終毀在奇襲與內部失能上；另一個是進攻方靠騎兵速度、屯田補給與輕裝疾行，把攻城戰變成了一次運動戰。羅馬軍團步兵那套重裝不決定戰爭、補給線才決定戰爭的邏輯，在統萬城下被完整重演了一次。
impactEn: The fall of Tongwan marked the collapse of Great Xia. Helian Chang was taken and executed, Helian Ding fled north to Tuyuhun and rebuilt a state there, and that remnant was not extinguished until 431; the northwestern hegemony Xia had built over some twenty-five years passed to Northern Wei in a single season. For Wei, the recovery of Tongwan was more than the taking of a city. The tuntian farms of Hetao could be restored and enlarged, the road from Pingcheng to Liangzhou was opened, settlement followed the garrisons, and the supply of horses and grain grew; that supply capacity was exactly what underwrote the great campaigns against the Rouran from 429 and the destruction of Northern Liang in 439. The Juqu house of Hexi, screened to the west by Xia, was left exposed and was removed in 439, when Liangzhou was formally incorporated and the unification of the north was completed. In the history of the city, Tongwan was among the largest rammed-earth fortresses of medieval China, and the steamed-earth technique and the scale of its works remain prime material for archaeology; the settlement later decayed as the river course shifted, leaving only ruins. In the history of arms the campaign offers two sets of contrast: a defence that fused heavy infantry with fortification to an almost insoluble degree and was destroyed by surprise and by its own internal paralysis; and an attack in which cavalry speed, agricultural hinterland and light marching turned a siege into a race. The Roman legionary's doctrine, that war is not decided by armour but by the supply line, was reenacted in full before the walls of Tongwan.
result: 結果是魏勝夏敗。426 年三道出師破夏兵於途中，但攻統萬不下，第一次出兵無功而返；427 年五月，太武帝率輕兵三萬再出，取道河套，避實擊虛，夜抵城下，拂曉登城，赫連昌出奔上邽，翌年為魏軍擒獲，押送平城處死；其弟赫連定等逃奔吐谷渾，另建政權，到 431 年被平定，大夏名號自此消失於西北。統萬城破後，魏軍盡取其府庫兵仗，馬匹以萬計，糧秣足支數年，北魏於城中置鎮編戶，其後城郭漸廢。從戰役方法上看，統萬之戰給北魏留下了三樣東西：正面強攻堡壘無效的教訓、以奇襲取城的樣本、以及河套這塊可以屯田的基地；北魏此後十餘年對柔然、對涼州的戰役，幾乎都建立在這三樣之上。對本站的兵器譜系來說，這場戰爭是重裝步兵母題的一個反面樣本：羅馬重步兵所代表的盾牆與縱深，在統萬這樣的城防面前並不能決定勝負，真正決定勝負的是攻城的器械、補給的縱深與突進的速度。
resultEn: The outcome was a Wei victory and the destruction of Xia. The three columns of 426 broke Xia's troops on the road, but the siege of Tongwan failed and the first expedition came away empty. In the fifth month of 427 Tuoba Tao went out again with thirty thousand light troops, took the road through Hetao, avoided the prepared position, reached the walls at night and took them at daybreak; Helian Chang fled to Shanggui, was captured the following year, and was executed at Pingcheng. His brother Helian Ding and others fled to Tuyuhun and set up a state of their own, which was not put down until 431, and the name of Great Xia disappeared from the northwest. After the city fell the Wei took its treasury and arms, horses by the tens of thousands and stores of grain sufficient for years, set up a garrison and registered the households, and the city decayed by degrees. Methodologically the campaign left Wei three things: the lesson that a fortress cannot be taken by frontal assault, the model of taking a city by surprise, and the base at Hetao that could be farmed; the campaigns of the following dozen years against the Rouran and against Liangzhou rested almost entirely on those three. For this collection's line of arms, Tongwan is a negative model of the heavy-infantry theme: the shield wall and the deep ranks represented by the Roman legionary could not decide the outcome before fortifications of this kind, and what decided it were the siege engines, the depth of the supply and the speed of the approach.
